name: claude-trading-skills
description: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.
one_liner: A set of AI assistant add-ons that walk a part-time stock investor through a disciplined daily market check, screening, and trade-journaling routine instead of trading on gut feel.
buyer: A time-constrained individual investor with a day job who wants a repeatable, disciplined investing process rather than a paid signal service.
business_use_cases: A part-time swing trader runs the 15-minute daily market-regime check before work to decide whether to take on risk that day.
A financial content creator uses the screener skill to generate a daily watchlist for a newsletter audience.
A trading coach builds a paid course teaching retail clients to use AI for process and risk discipline, not signal-chasing, using this toolkit as the base.

money_ideas.idea: A paid 'pro' skill pack with extra screeners, broker integrations, and structured journaling templates
A subscription newsletter or community built on the daily screener and weekly performance digest output

steal_this: Package the daily market-regime and weekly digest skills into a $9 starter kit for retail investors on Gumroad, with a short video showing the no-paid-API path.
